365:t_5:20.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's right. The person manipulating people's hearts is to blame.」

365:t_5:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「The question is what happens now.」

365:t_5:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「What's going to happen... to Miss $$スズネ$$...?」

365:t_5:23.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's no comfort, but we can be sure she's safe.」

365:t_5:25.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah! If we know that for sure, we just have to get her back!」

365:t_5:26.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't forget. We're dealing with $$バルビエル$$.」

365:t_5:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm sure he'll... use Miss $$スズネ$$ to hurt $n emotionally...」

365:t_5:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「So he's... acquired the perfect weapon...」

365:t_5:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「He's in his room... He asked us to leave him alone.」

365:t_5:34.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's a strong man. I'm sure...」

365:t_5:35.en:
$$メール$$
「...But $n... lost his father and sister in an accident...」

365:t_5:37.en:
$$メール$$
「He's been struggling with losing people he loved all this time... And now... if this happens again...」

365:t_5:40.en:
$n
「...So you're all here. I've been looking for you.」

365:t_5:42.en:
$n
「Could someone join me in the simulator? I would prefer $$カミーユ$$ or $$スザク$$, since they're good at close combat...」

365:t_5:46.en:
$n
「You're doing everything you can to save $$千鳥$$, too... So I have to...」

365:t_5:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「All right. ...$$スザク$$, I need your help, too.」

365:t_5:48.en:
$$スザク$$
「I'll help, if you'll have me.」

365:t_5:50.en:
$$カレン$$
「Me too...! If you want close-combat opponents, I'll ask $$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, and $$竜馬$$, too!」

365:t_5:53.en:
$$キラ$$
「If Miss $$スズネ$$ were here, she'd surely say that's one of $n's good points.」

365:t_5:54.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sheesh... If he wants close-combat training, he'd better not forget my $$システマ$$.」

365:t_5:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$セツコ$$... if it's special training, this is your cue.」

365:t_5:57.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Someone said it before, but watching him makes my short-straw instincts kick in.」

365:t_5:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're not the only ones who feel that way.」

365:t_5:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... When I see that quiet profile of his, I can't bring myself to leave him alone.」

365:t_5:60.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm sure Miss $$スズネ$$ felt the same way when she fussed over him.」

365:t_5:61.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ probably felt that way, too.」

365:t_5:63.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Now the question is what $$バルビエル$$ will do.」

365:t_5:64.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We all owe that man some payback.」

365:t_5:65.en:
$$カレン$$
「Whatever dirty tricks he pulls using Miss $$スズネ$$, we won't lose.」

365:t_5:66.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$バルビエル$$... I'll be the one to finish you off...)

365:t_5:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I've begun to understand a little... why you're after me...)

365:t_5:71.en: ～$$ターミナル・ベース$$ Research Facility～

365:t_5:72.en:
$$桂$$
「...Were they using you as a lab animal here?」

365:t_5:73.en:
$$オルソン$$
「They didn't treat me that badly.」

365:t_5:74.en:
$$オルソン$$
「It seems $$サイデリアル$$ intended to use me for something, since I'm an original $$特異点$$ of the multiverse.」

365:t_5:77.en:
$$桂$$
「I was doing similar work for Dr. $$トライア$$.」

365:t_5:78.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So that's where you learned it...」

365:t_5:79.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah... Repairing today's multiverse, layered by a chain of $$時空震動$$s, is practically impossible...」

365:t_5:80.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Forcing it would amount to destroying every parallel world...」

365:t_5:81.en:
$$桂$$
「...Though I'm told my power alone couldn't possibly affect the convergence point of the current dimensional boundaries.」

365:t_5:82.en:
$$桂$$
「If that collapse of the universe every 12,000 years was a spacetime disaster, I thought I could be our trump card...」

365:t_5:83.en:
$$桂$$
「But in reality, a crisis that comes once in 120 million years, not 12,000, is approaching, and I'm completely powerless.」

365:t_5:84.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So you had that information, too...」

365:t_5:85.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ is impressive. $$サイデリアル$$ apparently reached the same conclusion, with super-dimensional physics far ahead of Earth's.」

365:t_5:86.en:
$$オルソン$$
「At the very least, even with both our powers, we're told we lack the factors needed for $$時空修復$$.」

365:t_5:89.en:
$$桂$$
「...Sometimes I wonder what would've happened to the world if I hadn't set off the $$時空震動弾$$ back then...」

365:t_5:90.en:
$$オルソン$$
「...You probably would've married $$ティナ$$, and $$アテナ$$ would see me as just a friend of her father's.」

365:t_5:91.en:
$$桂$$
「So I would've never met $$ミムジィ$$.」

365:t_5:92.en:
$$オルソン$$
「And the world would've carried on with its futile war...」

365:t_5:93.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Perhaps the people who built the $$時空震動弾$$ were sick of a world like that.」

365:t_5:95.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Even $$チラム$$, twenty years later, couldn't complete a $$時空震動弾$$...」

365:t_5:96.en:
$$桂$$
「Lost technology... That's what they call it...」

365:t_5:97.en:
$$オルソン$$
「There were a lot of mysteries about that $$時空震動弾$$... I looked into it when I was a $$チラム$$ soldier.」

365:t_5:99.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I learned nothing about how it was developed. All the old records were gone, partly due to the $$時空震動$$.」

365:t_5:100.en:
$$桂$$
「We should look to the future instead of the past. ...I'm counting on you again, $$オルソン$$.」

365:t_5:101.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Yeah... I don't intend to die before I see $$アテナ$$ again, either.」
